name: Elephant sanctuary

seo.title: Elephant Sanctuary Koh Lanta | Secret Travel & Tour
seo.metaDescription: Time with the elephants on Koh Lanta, no riding and no show. Four programmes, from 1 hr 30 min to a full day, hotel transfer included. From 1,800 THB.

draft.title: Ethical Elephant Sanctuary Koh Lanta – No Riding
draft.h1: Ethical elephant sanctuary on Koh Lanta

lead: Time with the elephants near the Klong Jark waterfall, with no riding and no show. Add the beach, a walk to a waterfall and a hidden cave, or a full day around Koh Lanta.
promise: Four programmes, from 1 hr 30 min to a full day

facts.label: Duration
facts.value: 1 hr 30 min to a full day

facts.label: Children
facts.value: 4–10 child rate, under 4 free, adult rate from 11

options.label: Programme A, 1 hr 30 min to 2 hours with the elephants
Programme B, the elephants and Klong Jark beach
Programme C, the elephants, a waterfall and a hidden cave
Programme D, a day on Koh Lanta with the elephants
options.note: A shared day trip, not private. It runs with 2 paying guests at least.

steps.label: A
steps.text: About 1 hr 30 min to 2 hours with the elephants, with the feeding if you want it. Sessions at 09:00, 12:00 or 15:00.

steps.label: B
steps.text: Time with the elephants, then about 2 hours of free time on Klong Jark beach. Sessions at 09:00 or 12:00.

steps.label: C
steps.text: Time with the elephants, then a walk of about 2 hours there and back to a waterfall and a hidden cave, with a local guide who speaks little English. The waterfall is fullest in the rainy season. Sessions at 09:00 or 12:00.

day.title: Programme D

steps.text: Pickup at your hotel between 08:00 and 08:50.
Time with the elephants, 1 hr 30 min to 2 hours.
Mu Ko Lanta National Park, about 1 hr 30 min.
Lunch with a sea view at the Phu Pha View restaurant.
Lanta Old Town, about an hour.

day.note: Times with ≈ are approximate. The programme can change with the weather and the well-being of the elephants.

included: Hotel transfer both ways, from selected areas of Koh Lanta
English-speaking guide on programmes A, B and C
Feeding the elephants, if you want to
Programme D: the national park entrance and lunch

beforeYouBook.pickup: Programme A: pickup 08:00–09:00, 11:00–12:00 or 14:00–15:00 for the 09:00, 12:00 or 15:00 session. Programme D: pickup 08:00–08:50 depending on your hotel. Transfers cover selected areas of Koh Lanta.
bring: Closed shoes or sandals that stay on
beforeYouBook.children: Children from 4 to 10 pay the child rate and children under 4 go free. From 11 it is the adult rate.
beforeYouBook.health: The ground is natural and uneven. Tell us before you book if walking is hard for you, if you are pregnant, if you come with very young children or if you have a health problem.
beforeYouBook.cancellation: Please tell us at least 2 hours before your pickup time.

faq.a: No. It is an ethical sanctuary: no riding and no show. You spend time with the elephants and can feed them.

1 hr 30 min to 2 hours with the elephants on programme A. Programme B adds about 2 hours on the beach, programme C a walk of about 2 hours to a waterfall and a hidden cave. Programme D is a full day around Koh Lanta.

faq.q: Is it suitable for small children?
faq.a: Yes. Ages 4 to 10 pay the child rate and under 4 go free. The ground is uneven: tell us if you come with very young children.

legacyText.title: Ethical Elephant Sanctuary Koh Lanta | Secret Travel
intro: The sanctuary is on Koh Lanta. There is no riding and no show. You spend the time next to the animals, feeding them bananas, walking with them and washing them.
Sessions start at 7:30, 10:00 and 13:00. Come in clothes that can get dirty and wet, with a towel and flip-flops.
legacyText.cardDescription: Feeding and walking with the elephants, no riding.
goodToKnow: Children from 4 to 10 pay a child rate. Under 4 go free.
Programme C takes two people per session only. Book it early.
You will get muddy. Bring a change of clothes.
legacyText.priceNote: Prices in Thai baht. Children under 4 go free.
legacyText.caption: No riding
